71:1: Interpretation of Surah Nuh In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful God Almighty says, informing us about Noah, peace be upon him, that He sent him to his people, commanding him to warn them of God’s punishment before it befalls them. If they repent and return, it will be lifted from them. That is why God Almighty said: Warn your people before a painful punishment comes upon them. He said, O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner. That is, he made the warning clear and the apparent command clear. Worship God and fear Him, that is, abandon what He has forbidden and avoid what He has sinned. And obey me, in what I command you and forbid you from. He will forgive you some of your sins. That is, if you do what I command you and believe in what I have sent you with, God will forgive you your sins. From here, it was said that it is redundant, but the view that it is redundant in confirmation is rare. From this is the saying of some Arabs: It has been raining. It was said that it means that He will pardon you for your sins, and Ibn Jarir chose this. It was said that it is for partiality, that is, He will forgive you the great sins for which He promised you vengeance for committing them. And He will delay you for a specified term. That is, He will prolong your lives and ward off from you the punishment that if you do not avoid what He has forbidden you, He will inflict upon you. This verse may be used as evidence by those who say that obedience Piety and maintaining kinship ties truly increase one’s lifespan, as mentioned in the hadith: Maintaining kinship ties increases one’s lifespan. And the Almighty’s statement: Indeed, when the term of God comes, it cannot be delayed, if you only knew. That is, hasten to obey before the punishment comes, for if God commands that to happen, it cannot be rejected or prevented. He is the Great One who has subdued all things, the Mighty One to whose might all creatures submit.

71:5: God the Almighty tells us about His servant and messenger Noah, peace be upon him, that he complained to his Lord, the Almighty and Majestic, about what he encountered from his people, and how he was patient with them during that long period, which was a thousand years minus fifty years, and what he explained to his people and made clear to them and called them to the right path and the most upright way, so he said: My Lord, indeed I have called my people night and day meaning I did not leave calling them night or day in compliance with Your command and seeking Your obedience but my calling only increased their flight meaning whenever I called them to come closer to the truth they fled from it and deviated from it and indeed whenever I called them that You might forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears and covered themselves with their garments meaning they covered their ears so that they would not hear what I called them to, as God the Almighty told us about the infidels of Quraysh 106:And those who disbelieved said, ‘Do not listen to this Qur’an and speak noisily during it that you may overcome’ “and covered themselves with their garments” Ibn Jarir said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: They denied it So that he would not recognize them. Saeed bin Jubair and Al-Suddi said: They covered their heads so that they would not hear what he was saying. And they persisted meaning they continued in what they were doing of polytheism and great and terrible disbelief. And they were arrogant with arrogance meaning they refused to follow the truth and submit to it. Then I called them openly meaning openly among the people. Then I declared to them meaning speaking openly in a loud voice. And I spoke to them secretly meaning between me and them. So I diversified the call to them so that it would be more effective with them. "So I said, 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving.'" That is, return to Him and return from what you are doing and repent to Him soon, for whoever repents to Him, He will accept his repentance, no matter how many sins he committed, such as disbelief and polytheism. For this reason, God said, "So I said, 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving. * He will send the sky upon you in showers.'" That is, continuous rain. For this reason, it is recommended to recite this surah in the prayer for rain because of this verse. Similarly, it was narrated from the Commander of the Faithful, Umar ibn al-Khattab may God be pleased with him, that he ascended the pulpit to ask for rain, but he did nothing more than seek forgiveness and recite verses in seeking forgiveness, including this verse, "So I said, 'Seek forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving. * He will send the sky upon you in showers.' Then he said, I have sought rain with the angels of the sky by which He sends down rain." Ibn Abbas and others said: One after the other. And the Almighty said: And He will provide you with wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers. That is, if you repent to God, seek His forgiveness and obey Him, He will increase your provision. He will give you to drink from the blessings of the sky, and cause the crops to grow for you from the blessings of the earth, and make your udders flow abundantly for you. He will provide you with wealth and children, that is, He will give you wealth and children and make for you gardens in which there are various fruits and interspersed them with rivers flowing between them. This is the position of calling to God through encouragement. Then He turned to calling them to Him through intimidation, saying: What is the matter with you that you do not have reverence for God? That is, greatness. This was said by Ibn Abbas, Mujahid and Ad-Dahhak. Ibn Abbas said: You do not glorify God with His true greatness, that is, you do not fear His wrath and punishment. And He has created you in stages. It was said that its meaning is from a sperm-drop, then from a clot, then from a lump of flesh. This was said by Ibn Abbas, Ikrimah, Qatadah, Yahya ibn Rafi’, As-Suddi and Ibn Zayd. And the Almighty’s saying: Have you not seen how God created seven heavens in layers? meaning one above the other. Is this received only through hearing? Or is it from the matters perceived by the senses from what is known of the movement and eclipses, for the seven planets eclipse each other, the lowest of them being the moon in the lowest heaven, and it eclipses what is above it, and Mercury in the second, and Venus in the third, and the sun in the fourth, and Mars in the fifth, and Jupiter in the sixth, and Saturn in the seventh, and as for the rest of the planets, which are the fixed ones, they are in an eighth sphere which they call the sphere of the fixed ones, and the legislators among them say it is the Throne, and the ninth sphere is the Atlas and the ether according to them, whose movement is contrary to the movement of the rest of the spheres, and that is because its movement is the beginning of movements and it is from the west to the east, and the rest of the spheres are the opposite of it from the east to the west and with it the rest of the planets revolve accordingly, but the moving ones have a movement opposite to the movement of their spheres, for they move from the west to the east, and each one completes its sphere according to it, so the moon completes its sphere once every month, and the sun once every year, and Saturn once every thirty years, and that is according to the breadth of their spheres even though the movement of all in speed is proportional, This is a summary of what they say in this regard, despite their differences in many places that we are not going to explain. Rather, the intended meaning is that God Almighty: God created seven heavens in layers, and made the moon a light within them and made the sun a lamp. That is, He differentiated between them in illumination, making each one a separate model so that night and day may be known by the rising and setting of the sun. He determined for the moon phases and constellations, and He differentiated its light, sometimes increasing until it reaches its peak, then it begins to decrease until it is hidden, to indicate the passing of months and years, as God Almighty said: “It is He who made the sun a radiance and the moon a light and determined for it phases that you may know the number of years and account. God did not create this except in truth. He details the verses for a people who know.” And the Almighty’s saying: And God caused you to grow from the earth as a plantation - this is a verbal noun, and bringing it here is better. Then He will return you into it - that is, when you die. And He will bring you forth a complete bringing forth - that is, on the Day of Resurrection He will bring you forth as He began you the first time. And God made the earth a carpet for you - that is, He spread it out, smoothed it out, settled it, and fixed it with the firm, lofty mountains. That you may take therein paths - that is, He created it for you so that you may settle upon it and travel therein wherever you wish in its regions, corners, and regions. All of this is what Noah, peace be upon him, is reminding them of God’s power and greatness in creating the heavens and the earth and His blessings upon them in what He made for them of heavenly and earthly benefits. He is the Creator, the Provider. He made the heaven a structure and the earth a cradle, and He has provided His provision for His creation. He is the One who must be worshipped and made One, and no one should be associated with Him, because He has no peer, equal, equal, or equivalent, nor a companion, son, minister, or advisor. Rather, He is the Most High, the Grand.

A handsome man, good, “beautiful,” and beautiful with the first and second letters have the same meaning. The meaning of the Almighty’s saying: And they plotted a great plan is by their followers in making them believe that they are on the truth and guidance, as they will say to them on the Day of al-Qiyamah 75:Rather, they plotted by night and by day when you ordered us to disbelieve in God and attribute to Him rivals. That is why He said here: And they plotted a great plan * And they said, “Do not abandon your gods, nor abandon Wadd, nor Suwa’, nor Yaghuth, nor Ya’uq, nor Nasr. These are the names of their idols that they worshipped instead of God. Al-Bukhari said: Ibrahim told us, Hisham told us, on the authority of Ibn Jurayj, and Ata’ said, on the authority of Ibn Abbas: The idols that were among the people of Noah later came to be among the Arabs: As for Wadd, it belonged to Kalb in Dumat al-Jandal, and as for Suwa’, it belonged to Hudhayl, and as for Yaghuth, it belonged to Murad and then to Banu Ghatif in al-Jurf near Saba’, and as for Ya’uq, it belonged to Himyar, Lal Dhi Kila’, and they are the names of righteous men from the people of Noah, peace be upon him. When they perished, Satan inspired their people to erect idols in the places where they used to sit and name them after them, so they did, but they were not worshipped until those idols perished and knowledge was abolished, then they were worshipped. Something similar was narrated from Ikrimah, al-Dahhak, Qatadah, and Ibn Ishaq. Ali ibn Abi Talhah said on the authority of Ibn Abbas: These are idols that were worshipped in the time of Noah. Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid told us, Mihran told us, on the authority of Sufyan, on the authority of Musa, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Qais, Nor Yaghuth, Ya’uq, nor Nasr. He said: They were righteous people between Adam and Noah, and they had followers who followed their example. When they died, their companions who followed their example said: If we made pictures of them, it would make us more eager to worship them when we remember them. So they made pictures of them, and when they died and others came, Satan crept up to them and said: They only worshipped them and through them they were given rain. So they worshipped them. Al-Hafiz Ibn Asakir narrated in the biography of Seth, peace be upon him, on the authority of Ishaq bin Bishr, who said: Juwaybir and Muqatil informed me on the authority of Al-Dahhak on the authority of Ibn Abbas that he said: Forty children were born to Adam, peace be upon him, twenty boys and twenty girls. Among those who lived were Abel, Qabil, Salih, Abd al-Rahman, whom he named Abd al-Harith, and Wadd. Wadd was called Seth and he was called Hibat God. His brothers had made him black. He had children, Suwa’, Yaghuth, Ya’uq, and Nasr. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Abu Amr al-Duri told us, Abu Ismail al-Mu’addib told me, on the authority of Abdullah bin Muslim bin Hormuz, on the authority of Abu Hazra, on the authority of Urwah bin al-Zubayr, who said: Adam, peace be upon him, fell ill while his sons Wadd, Yaghuth, Suwa’ and Nasr were with him. Wadd was the eldest of them and the most dutiful to him. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Ahmad bin Mansur told us, on the authority of al-Hasan bin Musa, on the authority of Ya’qub, on the authority of Abu al-Mutahhar, who said: Yazid bin al-Muhallab was mentioned in the presence of Abu Ja’far while he was praying. He said: When he finished his prayer, he said: You mentioned Yazid bin al-Muhallab. He was killed in the first land in which other than God was worshipped. He said: Then they mentioned a Muslim man who was beloved by his people. When he died, they secluded themselves around his grave in Babylon and grieved over him. When Satan saw their grief over him, he took the form of a human being. Then he said: I see your grief over this man.
